offer.text: When the dark comes the little ones get frightened. Would you set out some lanterns around the village — six warm lights to say we're safe in here?

accept.text: Bless you. A lit village is a brave village.

decline.text: Then we'll huddle by the one candle, as always.

in_progress.text: How many lanterns are glowing now?

ready.text: Oh, it's lovely — like little stars come down to the fences.

complete.text: The children stopped crying the moment the lights went up. You gave us a gentler night.
